entities.name: UniProt P0C8K2 RPB2
observations: The 768-aa query matches residues 1–768 of UniProt P0C8K2 at 100% identity; the reference protein is 1,242 aa, so the query is a partial N-terminal sequence.
Pfam detects four RNA polymerase Rpb2 domains: RNA_pol_Rpb2_1 (39–457), _2 (268–418), _3 (507–577), and _4 (615–677).
Computed properties for the supplied 768-aa sequence: 87,104.69 Da; theoretical pI 8.723; GRAVY −0.3207.

entities.name: RNA polymerase II transcription
observations: The Rpb2-family identification is consistent with a core subunit of eukaryotic RNA polymerase II; this sequence-level analysis did not retrieve direct pathway annotation for the query.
